## Notable Projects

Arya Intaran has developed several high-profile projects demonstrating full-stack proficiency:
- **Aldi's Burger Brand Website:** A high-performance, mobile-first brand identity website using Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS mapping out dynamic menus and connecting physical stores with digital presence.
- **Automated Tech News Portal:** An SEO-boosting automated article generation pipeline fetching real-time tech news via RSS, generating Markdown with Gemini AI, and managing the state in Supabase. 
- **Modern Portfolio Platform:** This very platform (aryaintaran.dev), featuring smooth tabbed navigation, dynamic animations, and complex layout implementations.
